name: Deterministic Wake Gating & Circuit Breakers
objectives: Verify wake is blocked when agent is idle without new inputs
Verify wake is allowed on new task assignment
Verify wake is allowed when agent is mentioned or commented on
Verify breaker trips and blocks execution after 3 consecutive failures
Verify breaker trips and blocks execution after 3 consecutive no-progress runs
Verify token velocity spikes cause circuit breaker to trip
Verify budget warning is triggered at 80% consumption
Verify budget hard stop blocks any new agent invocation at 100%
Verify manual breaker reset restores normal agent operations
Ensure verifier regression chain rolls back to 3.1B
